newsitem.title: USA: Dow off more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow off more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in late afternoon trading Monday as the blue-chip market again failed to rally to the 8,000 level and investors were switching to the strong-performing technology stocks on the Nasdaq market.
At 3:23 p.m. EDT, the Dow index was off 55.05 points at 7,866.77, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
